title: Hardware Engineer
teaser: Become part of our team as a Hardware Engineer, contributing to the development of high-performance hardware systems for Service Provider routers. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, support hardware qualification, and debug system issues. Ideal candidates bring significant experience in system-level development and expertise in Ethernet and SERDES technologies.
description:
Meet the Team
We are part of Cisco’s Common Hardware Group, specializing in hardware system development for Service Provider routers. Our team focuses on delivering high-quality, power-efficient hardware using advanced SERDES technology at industry-leading bit rates. We manage the entire hardware lifecycle—from definition and design to qualification, release, and sustaining—collaborating with internal teams and vendors to address complex challenges.

Your Impact

Capture schematics using Cadence/Allegro

Collaborate with ASIC, FPGA, and Software teams for hardware bring-up

Support for product qualification

Debug issues in the lab and analyse system logs

Support cross-functional teams for product sustaining

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelors/master’s in Electrical or Electronics Engineering

8-12 years’ experience in system level development preferably in the server/computer/network industry

Experience in Ethernet, high speed SERDES (>25G) interfaces, high speed design and signal integrity

Experience in X86 architecture, and a very good understanding of control interfaces such as PCIe, MDIO, SPI, I2C

Experience in designing with DDR5 and SSD memory devices

Hands on board design knowledge, familiar with design tools including Cadence Concept and Allegro

Experience with hardware bring up and design validation of products

Prior experience with shipping products in troubleshooting field issues and Failure Analysis

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge on the signal integrity and system thermal design

Basic scripting skill for test automation

Good English written and verbal communications.
